{"action":"final","query":{"op":"none","scope":null,"id":null,"text":null,"start":null,"end":null,"offset":null,"derived_op":null,"groupBy":null},"diagnosis":"The selective log-softmax kernel incorrectly assumes unit token strides for IDs and masks and uses the ID batch stride for mask addressing. In grpo-02, IDs have strides (14,2) and the mask has strides (17,1): the actual GPU run produced 12/21 mismatches, with maximum absolute error 4.874395940741744. The dense control grpo-00 uses strides (7,1) for both and passed with 0/21 mismatches and maximum absolute error 3.2441425190654627e-7. Both runs preserved inputs. Pass independent batch and token strides from the sliced ID and mask views and use them in pointer arithmetic; this also supports zero-stride broadcast views and differing prefix lengths. Preserve the existing FP32 reduction, output initialization, and mask=None behavior.
